name: video-to-rag
description: Task runner for the Python project (uv, Ruff, pytest); the workflow entry points stay npm run …

scripts.check: uv run ruff check src tests scripts && uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix src tests scripts && uv run ruff format src tests scripts
scripts.preflight: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo 'working tree clean' || { echo 'working tree NOT clean — commit / git stash / git restore before proposing a new feature'; git status --short; exit 1; }
scripts.gates:dev: npm run check:affected && npm run test:affected
scripts.gates: npm run check && npm test && npm run secrets && openspec validate --all
